'''Reelo Baruk's hideout''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was located inside [[Reelo Baruk's Garbage Processing Facility|one]] of his waste management facilities.

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Kyle Katarn]] discovered this hideout when he was [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Empire Reborn)|seeking]] for [[Reelo Baruk]]. The two eventually met. After a short conversation with Katarn, Reelo activated the the [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] on the ceiling of the main chamber. While Katarn was fighting the autoturrets and incoming guards, Reelo escaped the hideout using a secret tunnel.
